 await t.test('DESTINATION lifecycle precheck/backup/install/postcheck/rollback/reinstall, data intact',async()=>{for(const suffix of ['precheck','backup',''])await q(await read('../supabase/folha_destino_operacional'+(suffix?'_'+suffix:'')+'.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_destino_operacional_postcheck.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_destino_operacional_rollback.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_destino_operacional.sql'));await q(await read('../supabase/folha_destino_operacional_postcheck.sql'));});
 await q("INSERT INTO utilizadores(id,empresa_id,nome,email,funcao,ativo,auth_user_id) VALUES($1,$2,'Encarregado destino sintético','destination@synthetic.test','encarregado',true,$1)",[id(781),id(1)]);await q("INSERT INTO obra_responsaveis(obra_id,utilizador_id,papel) VALUES($1,$2,'encarregado')",[id(102),id(781)]);
 const dstCall=(actor,body,confirm=false,token=null,connection=a)=>as(connection,actor,'SELECT fn_folha_destino_operar_v3($1::jsonb,$2::boolean,$3::text) v',[body,confirm,token]);
 const dstBody=async(person,work,intervals,extra={})=>{const f=(await q('SELECT revision FROM folha_registos WHERE colaborador_id=$1 AND obra_id=$2 AND data=$3',[id(person),id(work),today])).rows[0],daily=(await q('SELECT revision FROM folha_avaliacoes_diarias WHERE colaborador_id=$1 AND data=$2',[id(person),today])).rows[0];return {version:3,request_id:id(seq++),kind:'primeline',person_id:id(person),work_id:id(work),date:today,expected_revision:f?.revision||0,expected_daily_revision:daily?.revision||0,intervals,...extra};};
 const dstSave=async(actor,body)=>{const p=await dstCall(actor,body);return dstCall(actor,body,true,p.versao);};
 await t.test('DESTINATION receiving foreman records custom interval, preserves origin team and inaccessible facts',async()=>{await faltouWorker(770);await savePlan(770,[[100,[custom('08:00','10:00')]]]);const before=(await q('SELECT to_jsonb(f) f FROM folha_registos f WHERE colaborador_id=$1 AND obra_id=$2',[id(770),id(100)])).rows[0].f,team=(await q('SELECT to_jsonb(m) m FROM quadro_equipa_permanencias m WHERE colaborador_id=$1',[id(770)])).rows;
  const body=await dstBody(770,102,[custom('10:30','14:30')]),pre=await dstCall(781,body);assert.equal(JSON.stringify(pre).includes(id(100)),false);const done=await dstCall(781,body,true,pre.versao);assert.equal(done.record.minutes,240);assert.equal(done.record.intervals.length,1);assert.equal(done.record.intervals[0].period,null);assert.equal(done.record.intervals[0].start,'10:30');assert.deepEqual((await q('SELECT to_jsonb(f) f FROM folha_registos f WHERE colaborador_id=$1 AND obra_id=$2',[id(770),id(100)])).rows[0].f,before);assert.deepEqual((await q('SELECT to_jsonb(m) m FROM quadro_equipa_permanencias m WHERE colaborador_id=$1',[id(770)])).rows,team);assert.deepEqual(await dstCall(781,body,true,pre.versao),done);
 });

 await t.test('DESTINATION normal individual 5h morning uses daily legitimate 8h once, no artificial HE',async()=>{await faltouWorker(771);const body=await dstBody(771,102,[{...normal('08:00','13:00','manha'),mode:'normal'}]);const out=await dstSave(781,body);assert.equal(out.record.expected_minutes,null);assert.equal(out.record.intervals[0].mode,'normal');assert.equal(out.record.intervals[0].period,'manha');const ev=(await q('SELECT * FROM folha_avaliacoes_diarias WHERE colaborador_id=$1 AND data=$2',[id(771),today])).rows[0];assert.equal(ev.modo_dia,'normal_individual');assert.equal(ev.expected_minutes,480);assert.equal(ev.realizado_minutes,300);assert.equal(ev.falta_minutes,180);assert.equal(ev.excedente_minutes,0);assert.equal((await q('SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_he h JOIN folha_registos f ON f.id=h.folha_id WHERE f.colaboradorador_id=$1'.replace('colaboradorador','colaborador'),[id(771)])).rows[0].n,0);

 });
 await t.test('DESTINATION two connections same request exactly one history, payload conflict refused',async()=>{await faltouWorker(772);const body=await dstBody(772,102,[custom('08:00','12:00')]),preview=await dstCall(781,body);const outcomes=await Promise.all([dstCall(781,body,true,preview.versao,a),dstCall(781,body,true,preview.versao,b)]);assert.deepEqual(outcomes[0],outcomes[1]);assert.equal((await q("SELECT count(*)::integer n FROM folha_historico WHERE request_id=$1 AND action='save'",[body.request_id])).rows[0].n,1);await assert.rejects(dstCall(781,{...body,note:'changed'},true,preview.versao),/IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT/);});

 await t.test('NORMAL BATCH internal and external atomic, preserves existing facts, one request replay',async()=>{await faltouWorker(773);const externalBody={version:2,request_id:id(seq++),date:today,work_id:id(100),external_id:null,provider_id:id(300),name:'Externo Dia Normal sintético',role:'servente',expected_revision:0};const epre=await call(a,10,'fn_folha_operar_v2',['external_team_add',externalBody,false,null]),created=await call(a,10,'fn_folha_operar_v2',['external_team_add',externalBody,true,epre.versao]);const ext=created.changed_keys[0].person_id;const normalXs=[{start:'08:00',end:'12:00',period:'manha',mode:'normal'},{start:'13:00',end:'17:00',period:'tarde',mode:'normal'}];const body={version:3,request_id:id(seq++),date:today,work_id:id(100),people:[{kind:'primeline',person_id:id(773),expected_daily_revision:0,intervals:normalXs},{kind:'external',person_id:ext,intervals:normalXs}]};const cb=(body,c=false,t=null)=>as(a,13,'SELECT fn_folha_dia_normal_v3($1::jsonb,$2::boolean,$3::text) v',[body,c,t]);const preview=await cb(body),done=await cb(body,true,preview.versao);assert.equal(done.results.length,2);assert.deepEqual(await cb(body,true,preview.versao),done);const rows=(await q('SELECT minutes FROM folha_registos WHERE colaborador_id=$1 OR externo_id=$2',[id(773),ext])).rows;assert.deepEqual(rows.map(x=>x.minutes),[480,480]);await assert.rejects(cb({...body,request_id:id(seq++)}),/NORMAL_DAY_ALREADY_REGISTERED/);});
